description:
intent=i050 snapshot=s06 branch=hardirq-shared-lock status=complete
finding location=sound/parisc/harmony.c:306-323 confidence=medium conclusion=harmony.c h->lock is taken plainly by hardirq snd_harmony_interrupt (200-244, request_irq:937) and plainly by process-context PCM trigger callbacks (313/349) with zero irqsafe sites - same-CPU IRQ preemption spins forever; medium-confidence interrupt-context DoS.
finding location=sound/spi/at73c213.c:284-286 confidence=medium conclusion=at73c213.c chip->lock is taken plainly by hardirq snd_at73c213_interrupt (370, request_irq:905) and plainly by process-context PCM trigger (285) with no irqsafe variant anywhere - same-CPU IRQ preemption spins forever; medium-confidence interrupt-context DoS.
finding location=drivers/mmc/host/bfin_sdh.c:338-351 confidence=medium conclusion=bfin_sdh.c host->lock is taken plainly by hardirq sdh_stat_irq (478, request_irq:586) and plainly by process-context mmc ops sdh_request (338) / sdh_set_ios (363) - same-CPU IRQ preemption spins forever; medium-confidence interrupt-context DoS.
finding location=drivers/staging/comedi/drivers/ni_pcidio.c:369-372 confidence=medium conclusion=ni_pcidio.c mite_channel_lock is taken plainly by hardirq nidio_interrupt (402, request_irq:948) while COMEDI_POLL process path takes it plainly at 370 under a different lock's irqsave - mixed-discipline hardirq-shared lock, interrupt-context lockup; medium confidence.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/qlogic/qlge/qlge_main.c:672 conclusion=Follow up: enumerate every caller of ql_disable_completion_interrupt/ql_enable_completion_interrupt (660-684) in qlge_main.c and classify context; any process-context caller with IRQs enabled against the plain hardirq taker at 2510 is a reportable defect.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/realtek/atp.c:604 conclusion=Follow up: read atp.c timer path (atp_timed_checker:713-747, its timer_setup and any process-context caller) and confirm whether a softirq/timer-context plain holder of lp->lock races the plain hardirq taker at 604.
unresolved location=drivers/net/fddi/skfp/skfddi.c:625 conclusion=Follow up: trace skfddi.c llc_restart_tx (1284) callers and classify context; a softirq/xmit or process-context plain holder against the plain hardirq taker at 625 is a reportable defect.
unresolved location=drivers/char/snsc.c:46 conclusion=Follow up: read snsc.c scdrv_poll (336) and the file/char-device write path taking sd_wlock; a poll/write process-context plain holder against the plain hardirq taker at 46 is a reportable defect.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/isp1760/isp1760-udc.c:1276 conclusion=Follow up: classify isp1760-udc.c plain udc->lock sites 284/325/513/548/592/651 by caller context; any process-context plain holder against the plain hardirq takers at 1276/1315 is reportable.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/net2272.c:381 conclusion=Follow up: trace net2272.c net2272_done (381) and stop_activity (1487) call chains; a process-context plain holder of dev->lock against the plain hardirq net2272_irq taker is reportable.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/fusb300_udc.c:1071 conclusion=Follow up: identify fusb300_udc.c function at line 720 and its callers; a process-context plain acquisition of fusb300->lock against the plain hardirq takers at 1071/1207 is reportable.
unresolved location=drivers/tty/serial/zs.c:722 conclusion=Follow up: classify each zs.c plain zlock site (382-693) by caller context against the plain ISR taker at 722; any IRQ-enabled process-context holder makes it a reportable hardirq lockup.
coverage_gap=Handler-lock extraction resolved in-file bodies for handler names resolvable to identifiers; 747 registrations with expression-form handlers (function pointers, e.g. ath9k/beacon or wrapped dispatchers) and handlers defined in other files were not examined for lock usage.
coverage_gap=Cross-indexing matched lock expressions textually within the registering file only; locks shared across files via exported helpers or spelled differently (&priv->lock vs &dev->lock aliases) could be missed.
coverage_gap=request_threaded_irq registrations were treated via their primary handler; acquisitions of handler-shared locks from thread_fn (process context, IRQs enabled) were not separately enumerated, so threaded-IRQ variants of the defect may remain unreported.
coverage_gap=Deep reads covered the four reported candidates plus safe-classified files; the remaining unresolved candidates (qlge, atp, skfddi, snsc, isp1760-udc, net2272, fusb300, zs) were classified from the cross-index table and targeted greps only, without full caller-context tracing.
coverage_gap=Legacy s06 softirq-branch facts (f013 xmit, f021 timer, f035 tasklet-NAPI) were consulted only to avoid duplication and reuse context; no systematic cross-union of their lock sets with the hardirq sets was performed beyond the overlapping files already handled.
